entityName: Fundación para la Investigación del Clima
entityDescription:
The Climate Research Foundation (FIC) is an independent non-profit private entity which has a solid scientific profile and specializes in research into the climate, environment and climate change. The FIC is recognized as a Non-Governmental Organisation for Development under the Resolution of 17th May 2018 by the Directorate of Multilateral, Horizontal and Financial Cooperation of Spain.
The technical team at the FIC have been providing consultancy and research projects on the issue of climate change since 1992 and are specialists in the evaluation, design and start-up of initiatives aimed at strengthening the resilience of different countries in Europe, Asia and America, as well as in the development of plans for adaptation to future climate scenarios.
The experts at the FIC have wide-ranging experience in the development of analytical approaches and quantitative evaluation of meteorological and/or climatic risks, at different scales and in multiple sectors, as well as in the design and programming of computer-based tools based on Geographical Information Systems (GIS) for developing cartography of physical risks and to aid multicriteria decision making. In this regard, the products designed by the FIC have a clear communicative focus, through dynamic, interactive tools which allow simple yet flexible use by the end users, whether technical personnel or the general public.
The FIC has participated in numerous projects analysing vulnerability of infrastructures to climate change, including criteria for the design and application of measures aimed at risk management and reduction, giving particular importance to the use of Nature-based solutions (NBS).
The FIC has developed a statistical approach for regionalization or downscaling, to simulate future climate at local scale and has achieved excellent results, leading to international recognition and the opportunity to work with leading European research groups in the field of climate studies.
Having consolidated its capacity to generate future climate scenarios, the FIC has focused its efforts on providing high value-added assistance services to evaluate the impacts of climate change on various sectors and areas of intervention, including the analysis of socioeconomic impacts and the formulation of adaptation methods. In this regard, the FIC has carried out a number of important projects along with the provision of technical assistance to institutions in Asia, America and Europe, aimed at identifying, assessing, quantifying and managing the impacts of climate change on energy, biodiversity, agriculture, food safety, water resources, urban planning, infrastructures, health or tourism, among other sectors.

entityDescription:
Université Grenoble Alpes (UGA) is both firmly anchored at the local level and has a solid international reputation.

Its foundation stems from the aggregation of the former Université 
Grenoble Alpes and the most prestigious higher education and research 
institutions in Grenoble: Grenoble INP (School of Engineering), Sciences
Po Grenoble (School of Political Science and Public Policy) and ENSAG 
(Grenoble School of Architecture).

Over 60,000 students are registered at Grenoble Alpes University. 3,000 
of them study at the doctoral level and 9,000 are international 
students.

It has 7,500 members of staff based in its two campuses, in Grenoble and Valence.

Université Grenoble Alpes will pursue its collaborations, locally and 
nationally, with research institutions and networks such as the CNRS, 
the French Commission for Alternative Energies (CEA), the IT Research 
Center (INRIA), the University Hospital (CHU), and the French Institute 
of Health and Medical Research (INSERM). These strong collaborations and
the pursuit of joint research projects focusing on shared scientific 
interests will contribute to strengthening and widening the university’s
broad international partnerships.

Université Grenoble Alpes has three main missions.

- As a world-class university, it will seek to maintain and 
strengthen its local and international connections as a means of making a
valuable contribution to social, cultural and economic development
- It will fully and boldly embrace social challenges by offering a 
wide range of academic programs, by supporting research projects, which 
push back the frontiers of human knowledge
- It will address social, political, cultural and environmental 
challenges in a global context, whilst respecting its specific identity 
and diversity, and working in partnership with local stakeholders

MoS is a newly established company founded by a team with deep roots in the Università Politecnica delle Marche (UNIVPM) and a long-standing track record in European research and innovation projects. While MoS is a new legal entity, it draws on the consolidated expertise of its founding team in all phases of EU project design and implementation – from proposal writing and technical coordination to administrative management, reporting, and project governance. This enables the delivery of high-quality, innovative solutions with measurable impact.
MoS brings together academic rigor and operational know-how, with team members experienced in interdisciplinary research across sustainability, energy efficiency, digital innovation, and industrial transformation. Our portfolio spans diverse sectors – including environment, health, and manufacturing – with proven competencies in pilot demonstration management, ensuring effective implementation, monitoring, and replication of results in real-world settings. Our involvement in Horizon 2020 and Horizon Europe projects such as CLIMRES, DIGIBUILD, DEDALUS, SOCIOBEE, and BIMSPEED reflects our strong foundation in environmental intelligence, smart buildings, and digital services.
Beyond technical capabilities, MoS has extensive expertise in the Social Sciences and Humanities (SSH) dimension, supporting the integration of human and societal aspects into R&I actions. We design and implement co-creation processes, behavioural studies, and participatory methodologies that foster engagement, inclusiveness, and social acceptance. Our team is particularly skilled in managing stakeholder engagement, facilitating collaboration between public authorities, civil society, industry, and academia to ensure that project outcomes are relevant, actionable, and aligned with end-user needs.
MoS offers strategic services in communication, dissemination, and exploitation, including the definition of impact pathways, audience-tailored messaging, and the design of high-quality materials for multiple media channels. We organize and moderate international conferences, workshops, webinars, and training sessions, bridging the gap between research results and societal uptake. Our work is grounded in a results-oriented approach that links dissemination activities with measurable indicators, policy uptake, and replication potential.

entityDescription:
The Universitat Jaume I in Castelló (UJI), founded in 1991, is the public university serving the north of the Valencian Community (Spain). After 25 years of history, the UJI is now among the Top 500 universities in the world, according to the Academic Ranking of World Universities 2017 (ARWU), conducted by the Shanghai Ranking Consultancy. 
Our university seeks to promote social, economic and cultural development through the creation and transmission of knowledge. Our endeavours in this regard have enabled us to obtain a rating of excellence in teaching and research in the international U-Multirank ranking and the 500+ Gold Seal of European Excellence by the Excellence in Management Club.
The UJI hosts over 14,000 students and more than 2,000 researchers distributed in 27 university departments and 14 research institutes, focused on four main areas: Technology and Experimental Sciences; Medicine and Psychology; Humanities and Social Sciences; and Law and Economics. Our university offers 32 undergraduate degrees, 47 State-regulated master’s degrees, 21 UJI-specific master’s degrees and 20 doctoral programmes. All programmes comply with the objectives of the European Higher Education Area and students receive individual attention without problems of overcrowding.
The UJI offers modern facilities and services to support research, such as the Central Scientific Instrumentation Service (SCIC), a prestigious Library, the Animal Experimentation Service (SEA), the Ethics Committee, the Scientific Culture and Innovation Unit (UCC + i) and the Office for Cooperation in Research and Technological Development (OCIT), which helps with the management of research projects and the protection of industrial and intellectual property. Technology transfer is carried out through the Science, Technology and Business Park (ESPAITEC), which brings together innovative technology-based companies, research groups and public organisations.

The Silesian University of Technology (SUT) is the oldest technical university in Upper Silesia and one of the largest in the country. It was established in 1945 as a scientific and educational facility for the most industrialized area in Poland, and one of the most industrialized in Europe. For over 75 years it has been an important institution of public life. It plays a significant cultural and opinion-forming role in the region. The mission of the Silesian University of Technology, as a prestigious European technical university, is to conduct innovative scientific research and development works, as well as to educate highly qualified staff for the benefit of the knowledge-based society and economy, and to actively influence the development of the region and local communities. The university, through continuous improvement of processes and organization, is a friendly and open place for work and development of the academic community.

Silesian University of Technology is the only university in Silesia to be included in the prestigious group of 10 Polish universities, winners of the "Excellence Initiative-Research University" competition organized by the Ministry of Science and Higher Education. The university identified 6 main Priority Research Areas:
1.Computational oncology and personalized medicine
2.Artificial intelligence and data processing
3.Materials of the future
4.Smart cities and future mobility
5.Process automation and Industry 4.0
6.Climate and environmental protection, modern energy.

entityDescription:
Comet Aerospace is a company devoted to the development of innovative aerospace structures and antennas, starting from its conceptual design, and ending with the provision to their clients of flight components.

- Deployable booms (modular, articulated, hinged...)
- Metamaterials with structural and acoustic capabilities, able to reduce noise level in launchers.
- Traditional CFRP reflectors
- Other space structures, including launcher composite parts.
